$comment: A-ALG-002 single source of truth for Type IIS (Golden Gate) enzymes. Consumed by: src/editor/enzymeData.ts (frontend TYPE_IIS_SITES / menus), src/editor/assembly.ts (internal-site checks), and the Python sidecar via tests/test_enzyme_data_consistency.py which asserts server.py RESTRICTION_ENZYME_LIBRARY stays in sync. cutsTop/cutsBottom are 0-based cut positions measured from the motif start on the forward strand (same convention as server.py and NEB's recognition(+/-) notation where +N means N bases past the motif end).
